scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.2] — a `let` bound to a sync-impure builtin interpolates its bound VALUE end-to-end through the runtime's message path (cached() lowers to the FN_CACHE_GET cache-read op). Pins: now() renders the bound instant as a `Time` renders with no spec, [LTIM.8.2.1]'s `iso8601` in UTC ([LGRA.2.9.6.10]; `now()` is a `Time`, [LGRA.9.8.10]; the `let` has its right-hand side's type, [LLET.3.6]); a cached() hit renders the stored value; a cached() miss renders the empty string (null/absent bound value). Bound once per activation (LGRA.9.8.4), deterministic under the mock clock. now() reads the WALL clock ([LTIM.2.8.3]), which `set` does not move, so the instant is fixed with `wall_set`.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    tag: String key

rule rn:
    Trig t where t.tag == "n"
->
    let n = now()
    log critical "now={n}"

rule rw:
    Trig t where t.tag == "w"
->
    cache key: "k" value: 7

rule rc:
    Trig t where t.tag == "c"
->
    let v = cached("k")
    log critical "v={v}"

rule rm:
    Trig t where t.tag == "m"
->
    let m = cached("absent")
    log critical "m=[{m}]"
